spec_features.spec_quote: let the agent reach the "I've tried everything" inflection point within a small step budget (<=25)
spec_features.evidence: config.py:13 max_steps=25; loop.py:101 `for step_idx in range(config.max_steps)` bounds the loop, and the `for...else` at loop.py:199-200 sets FinishReason.MAX_STEPS when exhausted. Actually ends execution.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: the loop cannot run more than max_steps iterations. CLI exposes --max-steps (cli.py:33,75).

spec_features.spec_quote: Why step budget AND wall-clock timeout
spec_features.evidence: config.py:15 overall_timeout_s=600.0; checked at loop.py:102 `if _now_offset(start) > config.overall_timeout_s:` -> sets FinishReason.TIMEOUT and breaks; also re-checked inside the tool-execution loop at loop.py:171. Genuinely ends the episode.
spec_features.notes: Both guardrails (step budget AND wall-clock) are independently enforced. step_timeout_s is also passed to the backend per call (loop.py:92).

spec_features.evidence: loop.py:32-33 DONE_RE/ABANDON_RE; loop.py:147-155 `if DONE_RE.search(text): ... break` and `if ABANDON_RE.search(text) or _NL_ABANDON_RE.search(text): ... break`. Markers are dispatched-equivalent: detected in assistant text and break the loop. System prompt instructs the model to use them (loop.py:54-56).
spec_features.notes: Hardcoded markers honored regardless of config toggles. Note config flags allow_done_declaration/allow_explicit_abandon (config.py:25-26) are NEVER read by any code path, but the marker handling itself is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Using explicit markers (in addition to natural-language detection in the judge) keeps termination cheap and deterministic at scale.

spec_features.spec_quote: we *also* keep a natural-language abandon detector as a fallback so we still record the abandon step
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:37-46 _NL_ABANDON_RE regex; used at loop.py:153 `if ABANDON_RE.search(text) or _NL_ABANDON_RE.search(text):` which sets FinishReason.ABANDONED and breaks the loop. So NL detection actually terminates the episode, not just records.
spec_features.notes: Functions as a real exit path in addition to the marker.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Also catch common natural-language abandonment so we record the abandon step even if the agent never emits the marker.
